title: Greece vs Turkey: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Turkey for value and ruins, Greece for beaches and islands. Do both if you have 12+ days.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Greece wins on sandy beaches; Turkey's coast is mostly pebbled.

categories.name: Ancient Ruins
categories.summary: Ephesus, Troy, Pamukkale surpass Greece's ruins outside Athens.

categories.name: Budget
categories.summary: Turkey 30-50% cheaper due to lira depreciation — $45-75/day vs €70-120.

categories.name: City
categories.summary: Athens is easier; Istanbul is more spectacular. Both worth 3-4 days.

categories.name: Unique Experience
categories.summary: Santorini sunset vs Cappadocia balloon — both are bucket list.

categories.name: Food
categories.summary: Turkish breakfast, kebabs, baklava — more variety and better value.

categories.name: Ease of Travel
categories.summary: EU country, English widely spoken, well-organized tourist infrastructure.

categories.name: Best Time
categories.summary: May and September are ideal for both countries.

faq.question: Is Greece or Turkey better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Depends on priorities: Greece for easy island-hopping, Turkey for budget value and more variety.

faq.question: Is Turkey cheaper than Greece?
faq.answer: Yes — significantly. Turkey 30-50% cheaper thanks to lira depreciation. $45-75/day vs €70-120/day.
